version.changelog:
- Bumped version to 14.0.0.
- Updated SKILL.md metadata to reflect new version.
- Removed skill-card.md file.
- No changes to functional behavior or instructions.

llm.summary: This skill is a coherent paid-ad measurement workflow that reads user-provided campaign exports and can save summaries, with no evidence of hidden or harmful behavior.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to evaluate paid campaign changes against controls and produce Promote/Keep-testing/Rollback/Unproven decisions; the instructions and data flows match that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to user-provided ad, analytics, and ecommerce exports, explicitly treat exported files as untrusted data, and require asking for exports rather than scraping dashboards or estimating.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains only a markdown SKILL.md file with no bundled executable scripts, package installation, autorun behavior, or obfuscated content.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill may invoke an existing local ledger helper under CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT and references optional ad-platform APIs, but this is disclosed and proportionate to campaign measurement work.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: It can write reusable summaries under memory/ad/paid-measurement-loop/ and promote follow-up items to memory/open-loops.md; this persistence is disclosed and tied to the user-facing readback workflow.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Installers should expect this skill to handle campaign performance exports and optionally save measurement summaries. Review any saved memory entries for sensitive campaign or revenue data, and only provide exports or API access from accounts you intend the agent to analyze.
